question_text: In an agency division, the ratio of permanent staff to casual staff is 4:3, and the ratio of casual staff to job order staff is 6:5. What is the ratio of permanent staff to job order staff?

hint_ladder.title: Hanapin ang tulay
hint_ladder.text: Sa problemang ito, ang casual staff ang nag-uugnay sa permanent at job order. Pero 3 vs 6 sila, kaya hindi puwedeng diretso i-compare.

hint_ladder.title: Parehong bilang ng casual
hint_ladder.text: Gamitin ang LCM ng 3 at 6 (na 6) para magkapantay ang bahagi ng casual sa dalawang ratio. I-multiply ang unang ratio para maging 6 ang casual.

hint_ladder.title: I-scale ang ratio
hint_ladder.text: Ang 4:3, i-multiply sa 2: magiging 8:6. Ngayon, 8:6 at 6:5 na ang dalawa—pareho nang 6 ang casual.

hint_ladder.title: Buuin ang buong ratio
hint_ladder.text: Kapag 8:6:5 na, diretso nang makita ang permanent sa job order: 8:5. 'Yan ang sagot!

A.text: You might have chosen A because you directly paired 4 from the first ratio with 5 from the second, forgetting to match the casual staff c...

B.text: Correct. By scaling the first ratio to make casual 6, you get permanent:job order = 8:5.

C.text: You might have chosen C because you mistakenly used the casual-to-job-order ratio instead of finding the bridge to permanent staff.

D.text: You might have chosen D because you multiplied the parts of the first ratio (4 and 3) incorrectly to get 12, then paired with 5.

next_time_rule: When linking two ratios sharing a term, equalize that term's number using its LCM. I-scale, pagkatapos, diretso na ang A:C.
blueprint_id: Ratio and Proportion — combining continued ratios (A:B and B:C to find A:C)
deconstruct_text:
Sa barangay LGU, may tatlong klase ng utility workers: permanent, casual, at job order. Ang ratio ng permanent sa casual ay 4:3, at casual sa job order ay 6:5. Ang casual ang tulay, pero ang representasyon nito ay 3 at 6—magkaiba.

Para pantayin, hanapin ang LCM ng 3 at 6, na 6. I-scale ang unang ratio: 4:3 × 2 = 8:6. Ngayon, permanent:casual = 8:6 at casual:job order = 6:5.

Kapag pinagsama, permanent:casual:job order = 8:6:5. Diretsong ratio ng permanent sa job order: 8:5. Tamang sagot: B.

Mental trick: 'I-match si B, 'wag malito! Hanapin LCM, i-scale, diretso A:C!' Parang tuning ng dalawang gitara bago mag-duet.
